scope: Sole session-worker governed OSAR export/identity/copy with strict compact outcomes, exact in-memory request reference, independent retirement and distinct cancellation; actual schema-3 full-root inert OSRE qualification. Native raw activation remains closed.

precedingCandidateGate.reason: All commands ran on unchanged Rust code, but the included contract was corrected during the run. Its sourceStable=false result is retained and excluded from final acceptance; gate-final reruns every command against frozen inputs.

preliminaryToolOutputSummary.note: Preliminary observations are tool-transcript reports, not standalone gate logs. The final complete source-stable eleven-command gate above is authoritative.
observations: Initial runner check exposed a missing FailureKind import and private store Result alias; both were corrected before the final gate.

Initial OSRE tests exposed a nested module path and a borrowed PathBuf compile error, then all four refused a noncanonical test-fixture root. Canonicalizing only the newly created isolated fixture root fixed the tests without weakening production path checks. The four actual cases then passed.
The three public SessionService integration cases passed with real recovered/authenticated device-free fixtures in both performance profiles.
The full session library preliminary run passed 151 tests with two ignored helpers; the native raw-route guard passed one headless test.

reviewCorrections: Pre-effect reserve failure remains an outer known no-effect error; fingerprinting/result conversion is never performed unpaid after cancellation.

Validation accepts the actual initial partial store context, actual catalog source on export and paired stage/hash facts on second-check RecordedReplay; later impossible phases/placements are rejected.
Bounded reply syntax decode preserves a matching independent retirement core before semantic acceptance; explicit live-fatal fallback retires even if malformed body omits the separate DTO.
Worker EOF uncertainty is cached across repeated polls for non-retryable accepted mutations.
Design accurately describes a guarded ProjectSummary.problem rather than an executed failed Initialize or postcommit library fault.
capabilities: Three real public service cases exercise export, identity restore and copy through the actual worker in both v1/v2 performance profiles. They assert exact raw originals, complete source catalog preservation and deterministic mapped publication identities.

Exact copy replay succeeds after archive removal and later human rename, returns the original compact receipt and preserves the current edited document. Wrong-origin preflight refusal and lexical alias rejection leave the same worker usable.

Four actual OSRE cases qualify full-root inert schema-3 publication and copied ancestry, independent container framing/digests and complete catalog/raw-tree equality; restored evidence remains inspectable with its input archive parked.

Coherently rehashed false operation music passes untrusted encoding checks, is preserved as inert OSRE evidence and is rejected by active closure/OSAR validation. Missing registered originals refuse inert export.

Nineteen DTO unit cases cover bounded strict syntax, canonical fingerprints, result/context limits, retirement and constructor representations. Nine service controls cover exact credit/cancel/reference, malformed completion retirement, replay refusal, Drop and persistent EOF uncertainty.

The native coordinator headless guard rejects every raw new operation and an injected continuation, preserving document/name draft and queue, then paints a frame. No actual native window is exercised.

limits.notes: Token/retirement/fallback/late-cancel controls and acquired second-replay representation are injected/constructed, not physical failures or an executed concurrent replay race. OSRE stores claims inertly, without adoption or live IDs. Initial reservation cancellation returns an outer no-effect error. Recording shared finalizer limits, fixed-control/IO responsiveness, archive ceilings and ordinary legacy nonempty guards remain unchanged. A compact receipt grants no consumer authority.
